patterns_found.name: Double Top
patterns_found.evidence: Two distinct peaks are visible in the 1825-1850 zone with an intervening pullback to approximately 1775. Price is currently declining from the second peak toward the neckline area.

vlm_analysis.visual_evidence: Price formed a high around 1825, pulled back to ~1775, rallied to a higher high around 1840-1850, and is now declining at approximately 1811. This resembles the early formation of a double top reversal pattern.
limitations: The two peaks are not at exactly the same price level, reducing pattern reliability. The neckline has not been broken. The pattern could fail if price rallies back above 1850.
